homepage.body:
RuneScape Wiki

From the RuneScape Wiki, the wiki for all things RuneScape
Jump to navigation Jump to search
Old School RuneScape WikiRuneScape Classic WikiMain Page

Welcome to the RuneScape Wiki!

We are the official RuneScape encyclopaedia, written and maintained by the players. Since our start in 2005, we've become the largest and most comprehensive reference for the game, with 92,935 articles and counting.

  • Number of articles: 92,935
  • Number of files: 199,138
  • Number of active editors: 828
  • Number of edits: 10,088,742

12 October · Game update

The Ghrazi Blood Knights

After everything that's unfolded across Havenhythe this year, it's finally time to face the leaders of House Ghrazi themselves.

28 September · Game update

Havenhythe Part II

Venture beyond Amberfell. Find new adventures, rewards, skilling opportunities, and the next chapter of the Sanguine threat.

20 July · Game update

Mid-game rebalance

Mid-game training gets a rebalance across many skills.
